//: Library type-gen for the JS+JSDoc glue: type-check the public src under strict, then emit .d.ts into types/. `npm run build:types` runs `tsc` (emit); `npm run typecheck` runs `tsc --noEmit`. noUncheckedIndexedAccess is intentionally OFF — the hot path indexes structurally-validated tables whose bounds the wasm guarantees, and `!` noise there would bury the real invariants.
